import sys

def read_int():
    return int(sys.stdin.readline())

def read_ints():
    return list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()))

def print_int(x):
    print(x)

def print_int_no_newline(x):
    print(x, end='')

def read_vector(n):
    v = []
    for _ in range(n):
        v.append(read_int())
    return v

def print_vector(v):
    for i, val in enumerate(v):
        if i == len(v) - 1:
            print(val)
        else:
            print(val, end=' ')

def compute():
    n = read_int()
    nums = read_vector(n)
    nums.sort()
    
    t = read_int()
    
    left = 0
    right = 0
    best = 0
    n_len = len(nums)
    
    while right < n_len:
        while right < n_len and nums[right] - nums[left] <= t:
            right += 1
        best = max(best, right - left)
        left += 1
    
    print_int(best)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    compute()
